title: I Bought Two Cheap Chinese Aero Frames (here's why)

takeaways.text: He paid a little over AU$2,000 for the Elves frameset with integrated bar, about AU$600 more than the Trifox frame bought for comparison, and valued Elves' Australian site and support.
On his scale the size XL Elves frame, his usual 54 equivalent, weighed 1,280 g and its uncut fork 385 g.

Both the carbon repairer and the mechanic preferred the Elves frame; the mechanic found the Trifox head-tube bearing seat rough and sharp, while the Elves bearing seats and bottom-bracket area were clean.

disclosure: The creator says he bought both frames anonymously with his own money; the description links the inspecting carbon repairer and mechanic.
summary: A September 2022 comparison of a purchased ELVES Falath Pro frameset with integrated bar and a Trifox frame, inspected by a carbon repairer and a mechanic before the build. It concerns the pre-EVO Falath Pro.
